record.question: Britain of the South
record.explanation: Answer B: New Zealand. New Zealand is the country historically called Britain of the South. The National Library of New Zealand’s original catalog record preserves Charles Hursthouse’s book New Zealand, the Britain of the South and records its original 1857 title. Historical/source note: Historical epithet, not a present constitutional status or a general description of every former British colony. Reference: https://natlib.govt.nz/records/21730679. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
